title: Workshop Success
content: Today's workshop on resilience for the children at the foster system was a success. The 'Bright Futures Foundation' organized it, and the engagement from the kids was amazing. I feel we made a real impact on their outlook.

title: Case Update: Tommy
content: Received news that Tommy's Aunt Sarah, his last remaining family member, passed away. Tommy is an orphan under my care. This will be a significant setback for him, and we need to prepare for an emotional support plan.
